mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate amikacin's ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity through inhibition of monoamine metabolism and potential synergistic effects on renal function and eighth cranial nerve damage.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess baseline and serial auditory function, maintain adequate hydration, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible; if combination necessary, use lowest effective amikacin dose and monitor for hearing loss or vestibular dysfunction.
